raw_segments.text: Imogen, as I am mad I do, if you'll be patient I'll no more be mad, that cures us both.
I am much sorry, sir, you put me to forget a lady's manners by being so verbal, and
learn now for all that I which know my heart do here pronounce by T-H. Very truth of it
I care not for you, and am so near the lack of charity to accuse myself I hate you, which
I had rather you felt than make my boast.
